market_question: Will Mirra Andreeva win the 2026 Women’s French Open?
reasoning: Mirra Andreeva is a talented teenager but has yet to win a WTA title at any level, let alone a Grand Slam. Winning the French Open at 19 remains a rare feat, and the field includes multiple reigning champions and top-10 players in their prime. An implied 7.4% probability far exceeds typical market assessments for a young player with no major final appearances, making 'No' the value side.
evidence_points: Andreeva's career-best Grand Slam result is a fourth-round appearance (2024 Roland Garros); she has never reached a quarterfinal.
Historically, only a handful of teenagers have won the French Open in the Open Era (e.g., Swiatek at 19 in 2020), and they were already top-10 players.
The current elite – Swiatek, Sabalenka, Gauff, Rybakina – collectively hold the vast majority of Grand Slam titles and are heavy favorites for 2026.
At comparable odds (~7%), sportsbooks would list several top-5 players, not a rising but unproven teenager.
